verdict.rationale: Workflow Studio is documented as a no-code drag-and-drop tool for building/maintaining/updating verification workflows without developer involvement, and the Dashboard lets ops configure accepted documents by issuing country and type, supporting country-specific rules and template changes without deploys. However, the evidence does not explicitly describe risk-based routing logic or conditional branching based on risk scores within Workflow Studio. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of risk-based routing/conditional branching logic, and independent/hands-on confirmation of no-code workflow changes in production.
